description: This file is a shell script used to manage the startups and shutdowns of the Home Security HNAP process, specifically for the ccsphs service. It contains functions for starting, stopping, and handling IPv4 status changes, and references external utilities and source scripts that facilitate service management.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the ccsphs service if IPv4 LAN status is up and the service is not already started.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the ccsphs service by killing the CcspHomeSecurity process and updating service status.

methods.name: handle_ipv4_status
methods.description: Handles IPv4 status changes and triggers start or stop of the service accordingly.
